crossRefs.note: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
When David and his men had come to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made a raid on the South, and on Ziklag…
at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.
